question: Why is sign permitting/zoning regulated locally instead of a national code, and what makes a municipal sign ordinance legally fragile?
summary: Derived from first principles that sign harms (traffic, aesthetics) are geographically local unlike physical hazards (electrical/structural), explaining local police-power control; predicted content-based topic-sorting as the legal failure mode before checking corpus, matching Reed v. Town of Gilbert (2015) doctrine exactly. Subsidiarity/harm-locality framing itself is novel vs. corpus phrasing.
